comment: Scenes entered from the title menu (base `title`: a freshly formatted card, the defined point is the title menu 18/2/1 waiting for input), as scene_matrix.py's SCENE_NAV does on the port alone; here on both machines and with input.

covers: OPTION 32: the option menu as a new player has it (title_exit.c goto_step(32))

fields.name: bunkaken_flags:1
fields.why: option_menu_in.c: entry 0 (the minigames) is hidden while !(bunkaken_flags & 1) && !(taco_rec & 1)

fields.name: taco_rec:4
fields.why: option_menu_in.c, option_subgame_init.c: bit 0 opens the subgame entries

fields.name: opt_flag:1
fields.why: option_menu_in.c: entry 3 is hidden while opt_flag == 0

fields.name: 0x800F0204:14
fields.why: get_option_count.c: counts album_work[0x14 + i] != 0, i < 14 (album_work 0x800F01F0); 0 hides entries 1 and 2 (option_menu_in.c)

covers: OPTION 32 with every menu entry open (the system-file flags the menu reads), random input
OPTION 33: the sound test (option_cursor2.c goto_step(33) under the debug flag)
OPTION 34: the parameter editor and its scene warp page (option_cursor2.c / return_schedule.c goto_step(34))
